name: Advanced Baseline Imager Level 2 - Derived Motion Winds
description: Derives atmospheric motion vectors by tracking cloud and moisture features between successive ABI images, providing wind speed, direction, and pressure level for each tracked target. Vectors are reported as irregularly spaced point observations rather than on a regular grid.
